inlines.v: VI'SOR, noun s as z. [Latin visus, video; written also visard, visar, vizard.] 1. A head piece or mask used to disfigure and disguise. My weaker government since, makes you pull off the visor Swarms of knaves the visor quite disgrace. 2. A perforated part of a helmet.
